Feb 26, 2026Writing correct depth values is the subject of Sphere Tracing with Depth Buffer Output. The DisableBatching="True" tag is also required on both shaders because the vertex shader constructs the ray by reading unity_WorldToObject, which is only valid per-object and breaks under static/dynamic batching.
